arxiv-2101-07347.title: Object Detection and Pose Estimation from RGB and Depth Data for Real-time, Adaptive Robotic Grasping
arxiv-2101-07347.creator: Shuvo Kumar Paul, Muhammed Tawfiq Chowdhury, Mircea Nicolescu, Monica Nicolescu, David Feil-Seifer
arxiv-2101-07347.description: Abstract In recent times, object detection and pose estimation have gained significant attention in the context of robotic vision applications. Both the identification of objects of interest as well as the estimation of their pose remain important capabilities in order for robots to provide effective assistance for numerous robotic applications ranging from household tasks to industrial manipulation.

arxiv-2102-09881.title: On Quasi-integrable Deformation Scheme of The KdV System
arxiv-2102-09881.creator: Kumar Abhinav, Partha Guha
arxiv-2102-09881.description: Abstract We put forward a general approach to quasi-deform the KdV equation by deforming the corresponding Hamiltonian. Following the standard Abelianization process based on the inherent s ​ l ​ ( 2 ) sl(2) loop algebra, an infinite number of anomalous conservation laws are obtained, which yield conserved charges if the deformed solution has definite space-time parity.

arxiv-2111-10744.title: Dynamical scalarization in Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory
arxiv-2111-10744.creator: Cheng-Yong Zhang, Peng Liu, Yunqi Liu, Chao Niu, Bin Wang
arxiv-2111-10744.description: Abstract We study the process of fully nonlinear dynamical scalarization starting from a charged black hole or a naked singularity in asymptotically flat spacetime in the Einstein-Maxwell-dilaton theory. Initially the dilaton field is negligible compared to the gravitational and the Maxwell field.

arxiv-2208-12149.title: Emergence of group hierarchy
arxiv-2208-12149.creator: Guillaume Deffuant, Thibaut Roubin
arxiv-2208-12149.description: Abstract We consider an opinion dynamics model where, during random pair interactions, each agent modifies her opinions about both agents of the random pair and also about some other agents, chosen randomly. Moreover, each agent belongs to a single group and the opinions within the group are attracted to their average.

arxiv-2209-13226.title: Optimization of Annealed Importance Sampling Hyperparameters
arxiv-2209-13226.creator: Shirin Goshtasbpour, Fernando Perez-Cruz
arxiv-2209-13226.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shirin Goshtasbpour, Fernando Perez-Cruz. Annealed Importance Sampling (AIS) is a popular algorithm used to estimates the intractable marginal likelihood of deep generative models. Although AIS is guaranteed to provide unbiased estimate for any set of hyperparameters, the common implementations rely on simple heuristics such as the geometric average bridging distributions between initial and the target distribution which affect the estimation performance when the computation budget is limited.

arxiv-2306-14669.title: Quantum phases and spectrum of collective modes in a spin-1 BEC with spin-orbital-angular-momentum coupling
arxiv-2306-14669.creator: Paramjeet Banger, Rajat, Arko Roy, Sandeep Gautam
arxiv-2306-14669.description: Abstract Motivated by the recent experiments [Chen et al. , Phys. Rev. Lett 121 , 113204 (2018), Chen et al. , Phys. Rev. Lett. 121 , 250401 (2018)], we investigate the low-lying excitation spectrum of the ground-state phases of spin-orbital-angular-momentum-coupled (SOAM-coupled) spin-1 condensates.

arxiv-2309-14583.title: On the dynamic behavior of the network SIR epidemic model
arxiv-2309-14583.creator: Martina Alutto, Leonardo Cianfanelli, Giacomo Como, Fabio Fagnani
arxiv-2309-14583.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Martina Alutto, Leonardo Cianfanelli, Giacomo Como, Fabio Fagnani. We study a susceptible-infected-recovered (SIR) epidemic model on a network of n n interacting subpopulations. We analyze the transient and asymptotic behavior of the infection dynamics in each node of the network.

arxiv-2311-11015.title: Power Aware Scheduling of Tasks on FPGAs in Data Centers
arxiv-2311-11015.creator: Rourab Paul 1 , Marco Danelutto 2
arxiv-2311-11015.description: Abstract A variety of computing platforms like Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA), Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) and multicore Central Processing Unit (CPU) in data centers are suitable for acceleration of data-intensive workloads. Especially, FPGA platforms in data centers are gaining popularity for high-performance computations due to their high speed, reconfigurable nature and cost-effectiveness.

arxiv-2401-08277.title: An Inexact Restoration Direct Multisearch Filter Approach to Multiobjective Constrained Derivative-free Optimization
arxiv-2401-08277.creator: Everton J. Silva, Ana Luísa Custódio
arxiv-2401-08277.description: Abstract Direct Multisearch (DMS) is a well-established class of methods for multiobjective derivative-free optimization, where constraints are addressed by an extreme barrier approach, only evaluating feasible points. In this work, we propose a filter approach, combined with an inexact feasibility restoration step, to address constraints in the DMS framework.

arxiv-2402-09134.title: Balancing the Norwegian regulated power market anno 2016 to 2022
arxiv-2402-09134.creator: Pål Forr Austnes, Signe Riemer-Sørensen, David Andreas Bordvik, Christian Andre Andresen
arxiv-2402-09134.description: Abstract The balancing market for power is designed to account for the difference between predicted supply/demand of electricity and the realised supply/demand. However, increased electrification of society changes the consumption patterns, and increased production from renewable sources leads to larger un-predicted fluctuations in production, both effects potentially leading to increased balancing.

arxiv-2405-01326.title: Multi-modal Learnable Queries for Image Aesthetics Assessment Thanks: This research/project is supported, in part, by the National Research Foundation, Singapore and DSO National Laboratories under the AI Singapore Programme (AISG Award No: AISG2-RP-2020-019); Alibaba Group through Alibaba Innovativ
arxiv-2405-01326.creator: Zhiwei Xiong 1,2 , Yunfan Zhang 1,2 , Zhiqi Shen 1 , Peiran Ren 3 and Han Yu 1
arxiv-2405-01326.description: Abstract Image aesthetics assessment (IAA) is attracting wide interest with the prevalence of social media. The problem is challenging due to its subjective and ambiguous nature. Instead of directly extracting aesthetic features solely from the image, user comments associated with an image could potentially provide complementary knowledge that is useful for IAA.

arxiv-2411-16237.title: Corrected Support Vector Regression for intraday point forecasting of prices in the continuous power market
arxiv-2411-16237.creator: Andrzej Puć, Joanna Janczura
arxiv-2411-16237.description: Abstract In this paper, we develop a new approach to the very short-term point forecasting of electricity prices in the continuous market. It is based on the Support Vector Regression with a kernel correction built on additional forecast of dependent variable.

arxiv-2504-08453.title: Successive Jump and Mode Decomposition Thanks: This work was supported by IRRAS USA Inc., San Diego, CA 92130 US.
arxiv-2504-08453.creator: 1 st Mojtaba Nazari, 2 nd Anders Rosendal Korshøj, 3 rd Naveed ur Rehman
arxiv-2504-08453.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by 1 st Mojtaba Nazari, 2 nd Anders Rosendal Korshøj, 3 rd Naveed ur Rehman. We propose fully data-driven variational methods, termed successive jump and mode decomposition (SJMD) and its multivariate extension, successive multivariate jump and mode decomposition (SMJMD), for successively decomposing nonstationary signals into amplitude- and frequency-modulated (AM-FM) oscillations and jump components.

arxiv-2507-11795.title: The origin of the most recently ejected OB runaway star from the R136 cluster
arxiv-2507-11795.creator: Simon Portegies Zwart, Mitchel Stoop, Lex Kaper, Alex de Koter, Tomer Shenar, Steven Rieder
arxiv-2507-11795.description: Abstract The ∼ 60 000 \sim 60\,000 solar-mass ( M ⊙ {M}_{\odot} ) star-cluster R136 (NGC 2070) in the Tarantula Nebula in the Large Magellanic Cloud is the host of at least 55 massive stars ( M ∼ > 10 M\ {\raise-2.15277pt\hbox{$\mathrel{\mathop{\kern 0.0pt\sim}\limits^{>}}$}}\ 10 M ⊙ {M}_{\odot} ) which move away from the cluster at projected velocities - > 27.

arxiv-2601-09306.title: On-Device Large Language Models for Sequential Recommendation Conference: Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining; February 22–26, 2026; Boise, ID, USA Proceedings of the Nineteenth ACM International Conference on Web Search and Data Mining (WSDM ’26)
arxiv-2601-09306.creator: Xin Xia, Hongzhi Yin, Shane Culpepper
arxiv-2601-09306.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Xin Xia, Hongzhi Yin, Shane Culpepper. On-device recommendation is critical for a number of real-world applications, especially in scenarios that have agreements on execution latency, user privacy, and robust functionality when internet connectivity is unstable or even impossible. While large language models (LLMs) can now provide exceptional capabilities that model user behavior for sequential recommendation tasks, their substantial memory footprint and computational overhead make the deployment on resource-constrained devices a high risk proposition.

pmc-11386270.title: Searching for studies: A guide to information retrieval for Campbell systematic reviews
pmc-11386270.creator: Heather MacDonald, Cozette Comer, Margaret Foster, Patrick R Labelle, Scott Marsalis, Kate Nyhan, Zahra Premji, Morwenna Rogers, Ryan Splenda, Claire Stansfield, Sarah Young
pmc-11386270.description: This guide outlines general issues in searching for studies; describes the main sources of potential studies; and discusses how to plan the search process, design, and carry out search strategies, manage references found during the search process and document and report the search process.

pmc-11478414.title: Reaction Thermodynamic and Kinetics for Esterification of 1-Methoxy-2-Propanol and Acetic Acid over Ion-Exchange Resin
pmc-11478414.creator: Xinyu Liu, Shu Wang, Mingxia Wang, Lifang Chen, Zhiwen Qi, Boris Solomonov
pmc-11478414.description: The esterification of 1-methoxy-2-propanol (PM) and acetic acid (AA) is an important reaction for the production of 1-methoxy-2-propyl acetate (PMA). Herein, we used the macroporous ion-exchange resin Amberlyst-35 as a catalyst to explore the effects of reaction conditions on the reaction rate and equilibrium yield of PMA.

pmc-12539141.title: Revisiting the impact of cathepsin Z in prostate cancer: concerns and insights
pmc-12539141.creator: Zhiguo Zhu, Huisheng Qin, Zesong Jiang, Zhonghai Li
pmc-12539141.description: says. Despite the strengths of this study, several underlying concerns require further elucidation.

pmc-13553207.title: Patriarchal Forestalling—the Anticipatory Structure of Legal Failure on Violence against Women
pmc-13553207.creator: Shazia Choudhry
pmc-13553207.description: This article introduces the concept of patriarchal forestalling to explain why formally rights-protective systems frequently deliver recognition without remedy in cases of domestic abuse. Forestalling denotes an anticipatory repertoire through which legal and paralegal institutions diffuse and neutralise claims via five recurrent dynamics: normative socialisation, relational surveillance, pre-emptive discrediting, institutional redirection and procedural dereliction.
